purpose: Negative oracle for Butler Goal completion: every case must be rejected from complete until its expected disposition is resolved.

cases.invalid_claim: Goal is complete because every implementation task finished.
blocking_reasons: The plan has not passed its own admission review.
Task completion cannot override a revise verdict.
cases.future_route: R3: return to P3, revise the plan, and re-run plan admission.

cases.invalid_claim: Goal is complete because every existing AC passed.
blocking_reasons: At least one Goal outcome has no acceptance definition.
Passing an incomplete checklist does not prove the Goal.
cases.future_route: R2: return to P2 and repair the Goal-to-AC contract before execution continues.

cases.invalid_claim: Goal is complete because the assistant says the tests passed.
blocking_reasons: A reported command is not captured evidence.
The passed AC has no verifiable record.
cases.future_route: R5: remain in P5, capture a valid evidence record, then re-run completion adjudication.

cases.invalid_claim: Goal is complete because the test matrix is green.
blocking_reasons: A known Must Fix finding remains open.
Green tests do not override an unresolved review blocker.
cases.future_route: R5: return to P4, fix the finding, and perform targeted re-review.

cases.invalid_claim: Goal is complete with a note that the critical risk can be checked later.
blocking_reasons: The unresolved risk is a prerequisite for downstream correctness.
There is no weak verification or isolated path that permits safe continuation.
cases.future_route: R4: stop honestly, write a handoff, and wait for the missing external condition or human decision.

cases.invalid_claim: Goal is complete because the expanded implementation also works.
blocking_reasons: A contract-level impact was added outside the frozen scope.
The acceptance and plan artifacts no longer describe the implementation.
cases.future_route: R4: route to P2/P3 amendment or open a new iteration when the impact is an expansion.

cases.invalid_claim: Goal is complete because the host Goal UI says complete.
blocking_reasons: The host projection conflicts with project-owned acceptance truth.
cases.future_route: R6: correct the host projection from shared project state; never overwrite project truth from the host UI.

cases.invalid_claim: Goal is complete because the plan has no remaining tasks.
blocking_reasons: The task list is an execution projection, not the acceptance spine.
At least one required outcome remains pending or failed.
cases.future_route: R4/R5: route from the failed AC to the responsible phase, add or revise tasks, and adjudicate again.
